rows.component_basis: liquid TlO0.5 one-cation formula-unit mole fraction; two units per Tl2O parent
rows.parent_standard_state: the shipped Tl2O(l) parent at 1923 K uses Pankratz constant-Cp extrapolation above 1000 K, P672-Tl2O-l-CP-EXT-1000; Norris gamma uses Lamoreaux et al. (1987) liquid Tl2O, one-cation ln Kf = 1.67 at 1923 K
rows.source_citation: Norris, C. Ashley (2016), "Volatilities of Trace Elements in Silicate Melts", DPhil thesis, University of Oxford
rows.source_locator: Table 4.16 (PDF p. 170, Ch. 4 p. 140), mean 186 and range 28–1053 at 1923 K; Table 4.9 (PDF p. 128) gives n/2=0.5 and Tl+; §4.11.1 notes the Miedema estimate used for Tl.
limitations: inferred from metal–silicate partitioning (Kf + γ-in-Fe model); not a measured activity
single temperature 1923 K; the point is the Table 4.16 mean and the band is its printed min–max range
Section 4.11.2 judges all reported activity coefficients accurate within an order of magnitude; this bound is not used to widen the Table 4.16 band

the shipped Tl2O(l) parent at 1923 K uses Pankratz constant-Cp extrapolation above 1000 K, P672-Tl2O-l-CP-EXT-1000; Norris gamma instead uses Lamoreaux et al. (1987) liquid Tl2O, one-cation ln Kf = 1.67 at 1923 K

Norris §4.11.1 calls the Miedema γ-zero estimate an upper estimate for Bi, Cd, and Tl; the high direction for inferred silicate gamma follows Eq. 4.1, where gamma_silicate is proportional to gamma_metal
